event_name: Document 29 Date 08 April 2022 Time 20:40 2022 AUSTRALIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 April 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 21 & 22) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Impeding of Car 55 by Car 18 at turn 13.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz) and team representatives and examined video evidence. Due to the presence of multiple cars converging on the final corners, all of which impacted the situation, the Stewards consider that Car 18 did not unnecessarily impede Car 55 and take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Impeding Of Car 55 At Turn 13
